nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: Welcome, young one. We are the TekTribe — keepers of the old ways, weavers of the new. You have arrived at a time of awakening.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: The Tek has slept long in the earth. Now it stirs. You will bond with creatures of the old world — companions who carry the memory of the worlds within them.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: An egg will find you. Care for it. Warm it. The bond you forge in these early days will echo through generations. The Tribe watches with hope.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: The egg chooses its keeper as much as the keeper chooses it. Place it in the incubator. Keep it warm. The Tek within responds to care.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: A new life enters the world. This companion will grow with you — learn from you, bond with you. The bond is the foundation of all that follows.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: The bond is trust made visible. It grows through care, through shared hardship, through time. A bonded companion is stronger, braver, more resilient. It is the heart of the TekTribe way.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: Well done. Your companion feels your attention. The daily rhythm of care — feeding, cleaning, reassuring — this is the practice. This is the ritual.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: Your companion ventures into the world beyond the camp. They will face challenges, discover resources, and return changed. Trust in their strength.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: They return. Each journey teaches them something new. The world is vast, and the TekTribe explores it one step at a time.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: Training is not punishment — it is ceremony. Through play, your companion sharpens their abilities and deepens their bond with you. The Tek honors effort.

nodes.speaker: Overseer
nodes.text: The Tribe greets you on this day. Your companions remember your care. The cycle continues.
